issues.problem: The config maps SMSF_PERSON_ABN, but none of the example raw rows contains that column and no abn observations appear, so the mapping cannot be checked against the data. The column is probably empty or absent in the sample.

The envelope valid_from equals SMSF_REG_DT (the registration date) in every example, but the config declares no valid_from. It appears to have been derived from date_registered, and the rows are Capacity or Condition rows with their own start dates. Registration date and validity of the claim may not be the same thing.
The map_values transform covers only Registered and Suspended. Other raw values, such as cancelled or disqualified, would be unmapped. The suspension start and end dates are left unmapped.

The register has multiple rows per auditor (Capacity and Condition attribute rows), so SMSF_NUM is not unique per row. Hash_row is acceptable, but the repeated rows produce duplicate observations for the same auditor.
